newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Telkom gets cable deal with France Telecom.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Telkom gets cable deal with France Telecom.

text.p: South African telecommunciations utility Telkom said on Wednesday that it had signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with France Telecom on an undersea cable project from Cape Town to Malaysia.
France Telecom is the fifth party to sign up to the project, which has an estimated cost of $280 million.
Other groups that have signed MOUs are Telekom Malaysia, Mauritius Telecom and Cable & Wireless.

"The participation of France Telecom represents a significant step forward in the commercial development of the project," said Rhynie Greeff, managing executive of Telkom's International Business Unit.
Telkom also recently announced plans to build a cable hugging the coast of Africa from Cape Town to Senegal that could cost up to $400 million
